title: Design: tier names on hover in the Tiers column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, with a rule of its own in matrix A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Point at matrix A's Tiers value.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A's Tiers value lists numbers separated by commas, starting with 1.

Step 2:

  • A dark tooltip lists each tier as its number, " · " and its name, separated by commas (for example "1 · Default, 5 · Fleet").
  • The tooltip shows just below the value, as in picture 6.4.
